column1: Create Test Cases for First name Field
column23:
* Accepts alphabets and space only.
* Minimum 3 characters, maximum 50 characters.
* Numbers and special characters not allowed.
* Cannot be blank.
* Inline error for invalid input.
column70: Write Test Cases For User Registration

column1: Create Test cases for the mobile number Field
column23:
* Accepts 10-digit numeric values only.
* Cannot contain alphabets/special characters.
* Cannot be blank.
* OTP sent after entering number.

h4. OTP Field

* 6-digit numeric.
* Valid for 5 minutes.
* Incorrect OTP → “Invalid OTP.”
column70: Write Test Cases For User Registration

column1: Create Test Cases for the Email Address field
column23:
* Must be valid format (example: [user@mail.com|mailto:user@mail.com]).
* Minimum 5 characters, maximum 50 characters.
* Cannot be blank.
* Duplicate email → “Email already registered.”
column70: Write Test Cases For User Registration

column1: Create a Test cases for Password field
column23:
* Minimum 8 characters, maximum 20.
* Must include:
** 1 uppercase
** 1 lowercase
** 1 number
** 1 special character
* Cannot be blank.
* Show password strength: Weak / Medium / Strong.
* Accept only when Strong.
column70: Write Test Cases For User Registration

column1: Create a Test Cases for Confirm Password Field
column23:
* Must match password field.
* Cannot be blank.
* Error → “Passwords do not match.”
column70: Write Test Cases For User Registration

column1: Create a Test Cases for Terms & Conditions Checkbox
column23:
* Must be checked to enable Sign Up.
* Contains clickable link.
column70: Write Test Cases For User Registration

column1: Create Test cases for Sign Up Button
column23:
* Enabled only when all inputs valid and OTP verified.
* On click:
** Valid → Account created, User ID generated
** Invalid → Inline errors
column70: Write Test Cases For User Registration

column1: Create Test cases for Social Login
column23:
* Options: Google / Facebook
* Only authenticated login allowed
* First login → auto profile creation
* Duplicate → “Account already exists”
